title: 8 secrets of success
speaker: Richard St. John

keyTerms.definition: a very strong love for an activity
to give all your attention to one thing
not believing that you are good enough
to do something useful for other people
to keep going when things are difficult

predictionQuestion: What do you think very successful people say helped them succeed? Write two or three guesses.

keyIdeas.text: The project began when a teenager on a plane asked him what leads to success, and he had no good answer.
He then interviewed about 500 successful people over seven years.
Secret 1, passion: successful people do their work for love, not money.
If you do it for love, the money often comes anyway.
Secret 2, work: they work very hard, but they also have fun.
Secrets 3 and 4: get really good at something through practice, and focus on one thing.
Secret 5, push: push yourself, even through shyness and self-doubt.
Secret 6, serve: give other people something of value. He says this is how people really get rich.
Secret 7, ideas: creativity comes from doing simple things, not magic.
Secret 8, persist: keep going through failure and criticism.

questions.stem: Why did the speaker start this project?
options: A teenager asked him what leads to success, and he couldn't answer well
His company asked him to write a report
He wanted to sell a course to students
He failed in business and wanted to know why
questions.answer: A teenager asked him what leads to success, and he couldn't answer well
questions.explanation: At the start he says a teenager on a plane asked him a simple question, and he couldn't give her a good answer.

questions.stem: According to the talk, what often happens if you do your work for love?
questions.explanation: After the passion secret, he says that if you do it for love, the money comes anyway.

questions.stem: What does he say about successful people and hard work?
options: They work hard, but they enjoy it
They try to avoid hard work
questions.answer: They work hard, but they enjoy it
questions.explanation: He jokes that they are not workaholics: they have fun while they work hard.

questions.stem: How does he say people really get rich?
options: By serving others something of value
By coming up with one big idea
questions.answer: By serving others something of value
questions.explanation: He tells young people that you can't serve yourself: you have to serve others something of value.

questions.stem: How many secrets are there, and what is the last one?
questions.explanation: He lists eight secrets. The last one is to persist through failure and criticism.
